title: better-auth from 0.8.1-beta.5 before 1.7.16 and 1.8.0-beta.0 before 1.8.0-beta.5, and @better-auth/passkey from 1.6.25…
description: A vulnerability in better-auth and @better-auth/passkey allows revoked sessions to remain valid due to non-atomic updates of secondary storage session lists and reliance on cookie-cached sessions. This flaw enables an attacker with a valid session to bypass bulk revocation or bans, or to use a revoked cached session to register a passkey or create a persistent session.
